document.title: PGKhata / PG Manager Pro Codebase Architecture
document.verification_scope: Source code, configuration, migrations, and visible tests only; no deployed provider, environment, or database inspection.

product.name: PGKhata
product.domain: Multi-tenant PG and hostel owner operations
capabilities: Property, room, occupancy, tenant, and KYC management
Electricity reading capture and monthly rent/electricity billing
Manual payment ledger and due collection visibility
Email and optional WhatsApp payment reminders
Owner UPI deep links for tenant-to-owner rent collection
Public tenant self-signup and complaint submission per property
Subscription plans, coupons, Razorpay checkout, receipts, and history
important_limitations: Tenant rent UPI payments are not automatically reconciled because no tenant-payment webhook exists.
The WhatsApp POST webhook currently lacks Meta app-secret signature verification.
The repository contains a historical monorepo shape, but no active standalone Express/Drizzle/BullMQ backend.

root_commands.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

architecture.deployment_model: One full-stack web application. Browser pages use direct RLS-protected Supabase CRUD and authenticated TanStack server functions. Server-only services handle privileged jobs, webhook validation, external delivery, public token workflows, and platform administration.

request_paths.authorization: Supabase RLS using persisted browser session
Global client middleware attaches Bearer access token; server validates claims and creates per-request RLS client
Server-only key bypasses RLS; code must explicitly constrain owner/property scope

application_boot.router: src/router.tsx creates a QueryClient and router, enables scroll restoration and zero preload stale time.
application_boot.start: src/start.ts adds server-function CSRF middleware, client auth-attacher middleware, and a custom error response middleware.
application_boot.server: src/server.ts wraps Start SSR, normalizing swallowed h3 JSON 500 errors into an HTML error page.
application_boot.build: vite.config.ts loads root environment values for Nitro, configures Start/Nitro/Tailwind/React, and splits Supabase code from marketing chunks.

behavior: Redirects unpaid/cancelled owner plans to /plan, excluding /plan to avoid a redirect loop
Provides sidebar, property scope, branding, theme control and plan-status banner

owner_routes.feature: Current-month collection and occupancy dashboard, overdue bills, open complaints, scheduled/personal reminders, WhatsApp quota and scoped performance views.
Property CRUD, electricity configuration and per-property public signup/complaint link controls.
Room CRUD, capacity, rent, occupancy and plan limit UI.
Tenant and KYC CRUD, room assignment, contact validation, rent overrides, status transitions and file references.
Tenant bill/payment ledger, payment removal/recalculation and invoice export gate.
Room electricity meter entry, monotonic reading validation, usage calculation and history.
Draft/review/manual monthly runs, scheduled-bill approval, issue/send/delete/payment and document workflows.
Outstanding due collection, payment ledger entry, CSV export, manual and automated reminder controls.
Scale-gated collection analytics, property breakdown, trend and export.
Owner queue for public-link tenant complaints and status management.
Profile, billing/reminder defaults, owner UPI configuration, WhatsApp toggle/quota and sign-out.
Coupon redemption, monthly/annual plans, proration, Razorpay checkout, renewal and scheduled downgrade management.
Subscription change history and downloadable receipts.

shared_patterns: dynamic Supabase imports to avoid marketing bundle cost

access_boundaries.browser_client: src/integrations/supabase/client.ts; publishable key; browser localStorage session; RLS protected.
access_boundaries.server_function_client: auth-attacher.ts attaches token; auth-middleware.ts validates claims and passes an RLS-bound server client/context.
access_boundaries.service_role_client: client.server.ts; bypasses RLS; server-only and explicitly ownership-scoped.

public_http_hooks.operation: Runs unapproved scheduled monthly bills; validates optional month.
Runs due-date reminders and, except dry-run, scheduled reminder sweep.
Marks post-grace subscription accounts past due.

public_http_hooks.auth: HMAC SHA-256 of exact raw body with RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET
public_http_hooks.operation: Authoritative payment capture/failure path and idempotent plan activation.

public_http_hooks.auth: GET verification token; POST currently no Meta app-secret signature
public_http_hooks.operation: Webhook challenge, inbound logging and notification delivery state updates.
Exposes property/vacant rooms and creates validated tenant records.
Exposes property name and creates validated owner-scoped complaints.

rules: active tenants only
tenant rent override then room rent
property electricity rate then owner default
room units divided across active co-tenants
due date from cycle end plus owner offset
tenant/month uniqueness and ignoreDuplicates make retry/concurrent runs idempotent
cron bills await owner approval; manual bills notify tenants
payments table is authoritative
paid amount/status/timestamp are derived from ledger sum
direct bill-only settlement is intentionally avoided
owner enters/reconciles tenant rent payments manually
before-due/on-due/overdue scheduling
no duplicate successful reminder for bill on same day
three-day overdue cooldown
email plus optional WhatsApp quota-controlled delivery
UPI intent sends funds tenant-to-owner
owner manual sends revalidate/drop cross-owner bill IDs
scheduled and personal reminders share a pending/sent/cancelled table
Razorpay orders server-created
browser callback is convenience only
webhook raw-body HMAC is authoritative
atomic plan_payment status claim prevents double application
renewal advances cycle; upgrade preserves cadence and uses proration
failure releases claim for provider retry
token resolves property/admin server-side
client property/admin values are never trusted
signup only returns room labels and enforces capacity
complaint room number remains free text to avoid exposing inventory

database.ownership_chain: auth.users -> admins -> properties -> rooms -> tenants -> bills -> payments
database.multi_tenancy: RLS is enabled on owner business data. SECURITY DEFINER helper predicates owns_property/owns_room/owns_tenant/owns_bill provide dependent ownership checks. Service-role code must re-establish scope in application queries.
constraints_and_triggers: properties cascade to rooms and bills; bills cascade to payments; tenants restrict room deletion; tenant delete cascades bills/notification logs
room number is unique per property; tenant phone is globally unique; bill is unique per tenant/month
Auth-user signup provisions ordinary admin/settings records, while matching platform identity is made super-admin instead
super-admin audit log rejects update/delete to remain append-only
server-side plan triggers enforce property/room/Starter active-tenant limits
coupon redemption is a SECURITY DEFINER function; coupon rows have no authenticated read policy
database.schema_caveat: Migrations were statically reviewed and selected later migrations were consolidated. Exact production state requires replay/reconciliation against the deployed Supabase project.

controls: Browser uses Supabase publishable key and RLS; service-role key is server-only.
Authenticated server functions validate Bearer token claims.
Razorpay uses separate checkout and webhook secrets, raw-body webhook verification and length-safe comparison.
Public link authority is token-derived; server validates tenant/complaint fields.
Platform console enforces super-admin identity plus TOTP/MFA and append-only audit logging.
Auth reset/signup copy reduces account enumeration.

known_gaps.finding: No X-Hub-Signature-256 verification because Meta app-secret configuration is absent.
known_gaps.recommended_action: Add WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET, read raw request body and verify Meta's HMAC before status processing.

known_gaps.finding: RLS is bypassed and safety depends on explicit query scoping.
known_gaps.recommended_action: Maintain owner/property filters and cross-owner tests for every service-role path.

known_gaps.finding: No automated provider webhook/reconciliation for owner UPI payments.
known_gaps.recommended_action: Keep manual ledger workflow or add an authenticated reconciliation integration.

host_model.note: Cookies do not cross hosts; cross-host links must be absolute and app/admin should not be indexed.
